title: Marston load for negative projecting conduits

symbols.definition: Load on the conduit in kg/m
Unit weight of soil in kg/m³

Load coefficient, which is a function of the ratio (H/Bd) of the height of fill and the width of trench equal to the projection ratio p (Vertical distance from the firm ground surface down to the top of the conduit/width of the trench) and the settlement ratio rsd given by Equation 3.27.

applicability: Negative projecting conduits. Values of C_n for various values of H/B_d, r_sd, and p are given in Figure 3.36.
